Commentary.Commentary: Plenty of action still to come - Right then, one of the four warm-up games scheduled today is done and dusted and Ireland Women have bested a bigger opponent in the form of Bangladesh Women, which will give them massive confidence heading into the World Cup. For now, there's another game going on between Scotland Women and Pakistan Women, but it is currently raining in that game. Scotland have set Pakistan a massive target of 192 runs, and Pakistan are 62/5 after 9 overs in the chase. You can switch tabs and tune in to our coverage of that game. Cheers!

The skipper of Ireland Women - Gaby Lewis says that she is happy with the overall performance of the team. Adds that it's great to see someone like Ava Canning contributing with both bat and ball. On Aimee Maguire, she says that she's very happy for her and massive credit to the players. Ends by saying that she's looking forward to their first match of the main event.

The captain of Bangladesh Women - Nigar Sultana starts off saying that their bowlers bowled really well in the first inning, but in the second inning, they lost their shape. However, she reckons that Juairiya batted really well for them, but also feels that certain batters could do much better. About Meghla's performance, she says that she was not getting the opportunity to perform on big stage, he she kept on working hard and that is the reason why she performed well today.
Let's now hear from the two captains...

Lacking intent up top - Bangladesh Women lost Dilara Akter pretty early on after which Juairiya Ferdous and Sharmin Akhter added on a solid stand, but Sharmin got bogged down at one at eventually falling for 27 off 40 balls. Ferdous went on to score a half-century and got out soon after. The middle order didn't put up much of a fight

Maguire's day out with the ball - Ireland Women got the perfect start when Aimee Maguire got a wicket in the very first over and from there on, they were always ahead in the game. Maguire went on to clinch a fine four-fer but the others bowled well too and they managed to defend a middling score of 143 without much of a fuss.

A confidence boosting win - Ireland Women manage to get the better of Bangladesh Women in a close encounter and that barrage of hits from Ava Canning in the last over of the first innings made all the difference.

Georgina Dempsey gets the job done. At a certain point of time, it looked like these Bangla batters might pull off a miracle, but Dempsey controls her nerves and helps her team to get the win. Back of a length yet again, wide outside off. Shorna Akter yet again looks to pull it across the line, but gets the connection from the inner half of her bat, before the ball rolls to cover. Ireland beat Bangladesh by 11 runs.
